comparison.objective: Even wire tips and twist on a splice connector until snug; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable wire alignment and threaded connector twisting versus rigid long-rail handling, spring-prong latching, telescoping, and screw driving.
comparison.success_condition: Both wires captured at the proper connector depth without invalid turning versus four rail attachments and prescribed screws after release.
comparison.reason: Different material behavior, assembly mechanism, and terminal state.
